plan.failureSummary: Cached replay failed to find the radio button selector '[data-testid=\'radio-age-25-34\']' because the survey form fields have changed.
observedIndicators: Failure occurred directly inside the generated cache replay file (.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js:61:9).
The live page form structure changed from asking age group radio buttons to asking 'Occupation' and 'What interests you?'.
usedDeterministicMode is true and isRetryAttempt is false.
Overall objective 'Fill out the all of the survey questions with fake data...' is semantically flexible and easily adaptable on a fresh autonomous run.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and retry automation
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache for unstable-survey.test.ts and re-run the test autonomously so page.ai adapts to the updated survey fields.

plan.notes: The failure occurred within the generated .cache-lock replay file during DETERMINISTIC mode. Clearing the Page.AI cache will allow autonomous generation against the new form fields.
